label: Drift: isFlashMaxPinnedModel matches deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 and pinReasoningEffortForModel returns max unconditionally, yet agent-delegation.md prints -m llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017#high on nine lines including the per-route table and the captured-result recipe; the runtime can never emit those command lines, and the doc states the pin itself forty lines above examples that contradict it.

Bug: cli-opencode README structure tree prints opencode-setup.sh as a bare invocation, but the script usage requires one of v2, both, v1 or check and its four-arm case has a catch-all that prints usage and exits 2; under set -euo pipefail an empty first argument can fail as an unbound variable first. Every other page states the four-mode contract correctly, so the README line is the single stray.

Misalignment and operator UX: the cursor read-only branch never runs in the repository - it builds a neutral per-user temp workspace, fails closed on a symlink, foreign uid or planted .cursor directory, and dispatches --mode plan --trust --workspace neutral --add-dir repoRoot so repository hooks and MCP cannot write or hang a read-only leaf. No cursor doc mentions this; the doc read-only example omits --trust that the same file says is mandatory on an untrusted directory, so an operator reproducing it either hits the trust refusal or, after adding --trust in the repo root, loads exactly the hooks the runtime isolates away.

Drift: the OpenCode 2 branch hard-codes --standalone into every dispatch, but the flag table describes it only as running a private server, with no note that a child dispatch requires it; the requirement appears once in prose in a different file, and the same table note that v2 has no --dir pushes a reader toward hand-building dispatches without it.

Improvement: the same concept - what a sandbox tier means for this CLI - is expressed as inline derivation in the OpenCode, Cursor and Codex builders (the Cursor comment says it deliberately bypasses resolveCursorApprovalMode in executor-config.ts) and as a consumed pre-resolved value in the Claude builder, so a reader of buildClaudeLineageCommand must jump roughly 1260 lines to learn what a sandbox tier produces.

All dispatch argv construction for the CLI cluster lives in system-deep-loop fanout-run.cjs; the cli-external-orchestration hub ships documentation, manifests and one mode setup and probe code only, with no hub-level executable dispatch path.
